tests.id: manifestDependency.test.ts::declares zod with a semver range in game/package.json
tests.name: declares zod with a semver range in game/package.json
tests.title: declares zod with a semver range in game/package.json
tests.scenario: Given the game package manifest read from disk, When the zod entry in dependencies is inspected, Then zod is declared with a major.minor.patch version range
tests.detail: Matches /^\^?\d+\.\d+\.\d+/ against the declared zod range.

tests.detail: await import('zod') exposes z.object as a function.
